lines.trans: Careful, where are you hiding the poor dog?
Here in the locker room nobody will find her.
My God, what will I tell Dmitry?
Tell him the truth, that the dog simply ran away.
Dmitry Vladimirovich will be simply furious!
Calm down, she will soon come to her senses herself.
Why are you standing in front of me without pants?
My jeans are being washed in the machine right now.
Put at least something on yourself quickly!
First let us carefully put the dog here.
Fine, put her quietly on the bottom shelf.
Everything will be fine, nobody will find out anything!

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: They have to be washed carefully by hand.
Put the glasses carefully on the table.

examples.text: Ты что, Аркашка? Это же югославские вещи! Их аккуратно руками надо стирать.
examples.trans: Are you crazy, Arkashka? These are Yugoslavian things! They have to be washed carefully by hand.

examples.text: Я ухожу. Ваш сын будет бедным и честным.
examples.trans: I'm leaving. Your son will be poor and honest.

meanings.note: слава богу = thank God (literally 'glory to God')

examples.text: О, наконец тепло! Слава богу. Сейчас ещё чай сделаю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's warm at last! Thank goodness. Now I'll make some tea too.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.
My jeans are in the wash right now.
My only jeans are in the wash right now.

meanings.note: for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?
All right, here you go. There, look.
And this is for you. A toy car!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: to put on (an item of clothing)

examples.trans: He put on his best suit.

examples.text: Карамельно-сливочный цвет. Очень тебе к лицу! Надень куртку.
examples.trans: A caramel-cream colour. It really suits you! Put the jacket on.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to find', paired with 'находить'.

examples.text: Ну где я сейчас найду грузчиков?
examples.trans: Well, where am I going to find movers right now?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Ладно, положи её тихо на нижнюю полку.
examples.trans: Fine, put her quietly on the bottom shelf.

meanings.note: needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.text: Паша, я больше не хочу о ней слышать. Понял?
examples.trans: Pasha, I don't want to hear about her again. Understood?
I'm standing in front of you.
There's a car in front of the house.

examples.text: Не бросайте трубку, умоляю вас! Я перед вами стою на коленях.
examples.trans: Don't hang up, I'm begging you! I'm on my knees in front of you.

examples.text: Возьми хорошую бутылку на верхней полке.
examples.trans: Take a good bottle on the top shelf.

examples.text: А теперь внимательно посмотри на эту полку.
examples.trans: And now look carefully at this shelf.

examples.text: Мы проверили все столы и полки.
examples.trans: We checked all tables and shelves.

meanings.en: to put, to place, to lay down

examples.text: В гроб с собой икру не положишь!
examples.trans: You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!
Put the keys on the table.

examples.text: А вот сюда я её и положу! Отличный подарок будет!
examples.trans: Right here is where I will put it! It will be an excellent gift!
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine
as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Преступники прятали у слепых плохую траву!
examples.trans: Criminals were hiding bad herbs at the blind society!
What are you hiding behind your back?

examples.text: Пишут, что преступники прятали у слепых плохую траву!
examples.trans: They write that criminals were hiding bad herbs at the blind society!
The waiters change clothes in the locker room.

examples.text: Хорошо, пойдём скорее в нашу раздевалку.
examples.trans: Alright, let's go quickly into our locker room.

examples.text: Тогда иди быстрее в раздевалку персонала.
examples.trans: Then go faster to the staff locker room.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

examples.text: А с Пашей я снова чувствую себя женщиной.
examples.trans: And with Pasha I feel like a woman again.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Так, не шумим. Я скоро вернусь.
examples.trans: Right, no noise. I'll be back soon.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'начала').

examples.trans: First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Мы танцевали. Сначала они там грубили, оскорбляли.
examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.

meanings.note: grammatically feminine even for a male dog

meanings.en: to be washed, to be in the wash

examples.trans: The jeans are being washed in the machine.

examples.text: Мои джинсы сейчас стираются в машинке.
examples.trans: My jeans are being washed in the machine right now.

meanings.note: the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order
the infinitive 'Стоять!' as a police order

examples.text: То есть просто стоять и смотреть?
examples.trans: So we just stand and watch?
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: убегу, убежишь, ..., убегут

examples.trans: The dog ran away into the courtyard.

examples.text: Всё, убежал! Тут уже ничего не сделать.
examples.trans: That's it, he ran away! Nothing can be done here now.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'знать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to recognise; to find out', paired with 'узнавать'.

examples.trans: I'll find out where he is.
You recognised me. Thanks for seeing me.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'спокоиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to calm down', paired with 'успокаиваться'.
дай хоть одну = give me just one

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: any thing at all, not a particular one

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.
Are you doing anything about it?
Are the pants too long for Slavik?

examples.text: Ты почему стоишь передо мной без штанов?
examples.trans: Why are you standing in front of me without pants?

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'fury, rage' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Шеф будет в ярости, если узнает!
examples.trans: The chef will be furious if he finds out!
It seems the chef is in a real fury.
